title: Bridging Modalities: Enhancing Cross-Modality Hate Speech Detection with Few-Shot In-Context Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hate speech classification accuracy and F1 scores of LLMs on the MAMI (Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification) dataset and gender-based subsets of the FHM dataset using few-shot in-context learning.

Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification performance on racially targeted hate speech and memes using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) and Latent Hatred datasets, supported by rationale generation analysis.

Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification performance on religiously targeted hate speech and memes using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) and Latent Hatred datasets, supported by rationale generation analysis.
Measuring multimodal hate speech detection capabilities on nationality-based hate incitement using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) dataset.
Measuring multimodal hate speech detection capabilities on disability-based hate incitement using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) dataset.
